info.name: AccuWeather One Active Storms Autocomplete API
AccuWeather Retrieves a List of Locations Matching the Specified Query

params.name: Query
params.description: The partial query to search against. Eg. 'New' to get things like New York or New Market

params.name: Latitude
params.description: The latitude where responses will be biased.

params.name: Longitude
params.description: The longitude where responses will be biased.

params.name: Locale
params.description: ISO 639-2 and ISO 3166-1 code for the locale

params.name: MeasurementDisplay
params.description: Display type for weather conditions and distance

params.name: WindUnit
params.description: Additional display type for wind direction

items.docs: AccuWeather Retrieves a List of Locations Matching the Specified Query
